name: slot-booker
description: Lightweight slot-booking app for small clubs, on the Cloudflare free tier.

DB.description: Your club's booking database. Cloudflare creates it for you, so the suggested name is fine.

SETUP_CODE.description: A private phrase you choose, at least 12 characters long. Keep it to yourself. You will type it once on your new site's /setup page to create your admin sign-in secret, and that page closes for good after the first successful sign-in.
